title: Cleanup
intro: Objects that look unused or left over, each with the reason. Something is a candidate only when every list that could refer to it was read in full; when in doubt it is left out. Nothing is deleted until you select objects and confirm.
chooseNamespaceText: This page checks the namespaces chosen in the namespace filter. Choose one or more namespaces to start.
firstNamespaces_one: Only the first {{count}} chosen namespace is checked.
firstNamespaces_other: Only the first {{count}} chosen namespaces are checked.
excludedInView: Not checked, excluded in the settings: {{names}}
configsOff: ConfigMaps and Secrets are not checked. They can be turned on in the settings.
configsWarning: Sextant cannot see every reference to a ConfigMap or Secret: operators and custom resources it does not know, CSI drivers, controller arguments and applications that read them through the API. Check each one before deleting it.
blocked: ConfigMaps, Secrets, PersistentVolumeClaims and Services of {{namespace}} are not judged: it holds objects of kinds Sextant does not read ({{kinds}}).
unavailableGroups: Some API groups do not answer ({{groups}}): their objects cannot be seen, so no ConfigMap, Secret, PersistentVolumeClaim, Service or namespace is offered.
clusterFailed: Could not check the cluster-wide objects and API groups: no ConfigMap, Secret, PersistentVolumeClaim, Service or namespace is offered.
clusterUnread: Could not read every object of these cluster-wide kinds, so no ConfigMap or Secret is offered: {{kinds}}
sampleFailed: Could not check everything {{namespace}} holds: its ConfigMaps, Secrets, PersistentVolumeClaims and the namespace itself are not offered.
nothingChecked: Every chosen namespace is excluded in the settings.
unchecked: Some objects were not judged because these lists are not read in full yet: {{kinds}}
none: Nothing to clean up in the checked namespaces.
truncated_one: There are too many candidates: only the first {{count}} is listed.
truncated_other: There are too many candidates: only the first {{count}} are listed.

rule.replicaSet: Old ReplicaSets beyond the revision history

reason.configMapUnused: No Pod, pod template or other watched object refers to it.
reason.secretUnused: No Pod, pod template, ServiceAccount, Ingress, Gateway, cert-manager or Flux object refers to it.
reason.claimUnmounted: No Pod mounts it, and no pod template, StatefulSet, VolumeSnapshot or other claim refers to it.
reason.volumeAvailable: Available and not bound to any claim.
reason.serviceNoEndpoints: Has no endpoints, and its selector matches no Pod and no pod template.
reason.serviceNoSelector: Has no selector, no endpoints and no Endpoints object.
reason.replicaSetHistory: Revision {{revision}} of Deployment {{deployment}}, beyond its revisionHistoryLimit: {{limit}}.
reason.podSucceeded: Succeeded, and no Job owns it.
reason.podFailed: Failed, and no Job owns it.
reason.jobComplete: Completed; no CronJob owns it and ttlSecondsAfterFinished is not set.
reason.jobFailed: Failed; no CronJob owns it and ttlSecondsAfterFinished is not set.
reason.namespaceEmpty: Holds no objects of the checked kinds besides what Kubernetes creates in every namespace. Objects of other kinds are not checked.

note.reclaimDelete: Its volume {{volume}} has reclaim policy Delete: the data will be deleted.
note.reclaimRetain: Its volume {{volume}} has reclaim policy Retain: the data stays on the storage.

managed.title: Managed by a tool, not offered for deletion
managed.text: These look unused too, but a tool manages them: it would create them again or lose track of them. Remove them through the tool.

kept.title: Kept on purpose, not offered for deletion
kept.retain: Reclaim policy Retain: the data is kept on purpose.

settings.title: Cleanup settings
settings.checkConfigMaps: Offer ConfigMaps nothing seems to use
settings.checkSecrets: Offer Secrets nothing seems to use
settings.excludedHint: One per line. kube-system, kube-public and kube-node-lease are never checked.
settings.days: Offer only objects older than this, in days

ages.configs: ConfigMaps and Secrets: days since created
ages.pods: Finished Pods: days since they finished
ages.jobs: Finished Jobs: days since they finished

dialog.text: Each object is checked again right before it is deleted: one that changed or is in use again is kept. A deletion cannot be undone.
dialog.namespaceWarning: Deleting a namespace deletes everything in it, including objects of kinds this page does not check.

outcome.changed: Kept: changed since it was checked
